criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Create a product page using an Effect and local API URL. Display products after a successful response and record the initial and loaded UI. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Model loading, success, empty and error states explicitly. Provide a local mock for each and verify the right content is visible. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add a search query or category input used in the request URL. Include reactive dependencies and demonstrate changed input fetches the corresponding data. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use AbortController on cleanup and ignore cancellation errors. Navigate away during a delayed request and verify no obsolete update is applied. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Delay query A longer than query B, request A then B, and prove B remains displayed when A finishes. Use cancellation or an active-request guard. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Provide a retry button after an error. Demonstrate failed -> loading -> success with a deterministic mock without forcing a full page reload. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Compute filtered visible products or inventory total directly from current data where appropriate. Explain why storing the derived value via another Effect risks unnecessary synchronization. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
